subtitle: Root-cause analysis for one incident, projected read-only from the append-only audit log. An RCA result is an evidence-backed hypothesis, never an authoritative final decision; execution eligibility stays with the safety check (risk gate) and verifier.
idle: Enter a correlation id and fetch to see its root-cause analysis.
abstainedNotice: This hypothesis is not supported by evidence. It is held for review and routed to human approval, and is never treated as a confident cause.
noResponse: No linked response action has been recorded for this incident yet.
notRecordedBody: This incident has audit activity, but no evidence-backed root-cause hypothesis has been recorded. The latest generic activity is not shown as a response plan or cause.
viewPurpose: Per-incident root-cause analysis projected from the audit log: tiered evidence-backed hypotheses, citations, causal reasoning, and the linked response plan. Read-only; an RCA hypothesis answers why, never execute.
readOnlyBody: Confidence does not grant execution eligibility. An ungrounded result abstains and moves to human approval instead of presenting a cause.
lookupHelp: Loads the recorded read-only RCA projection for this correlation.
confidenceLabel: Grounded hypothesis confidence {value}. Confidence does not grant action authority.
reasonUnavailable: No additional recorded explanation is available.
hypothesisCaveatBody: The cause remains reviewable and can be superseded by stronger evidence. Every cited record remains linked to the append-only audit trail.
abstainedCauseTitle: Insufficient grounding - no root cause presented
